seo.description: Upload images and let AI write titles, keywords and categories that match what is really in them. Export a CSV ready for Adobe Stock. Start free.

howItWorks.title: Three simple steps
howItWorks.subtitle: From a folder of images to a CSV ready for Adobe Stock

steps.title: Upload images
steps.body: Drag and drop many JPG, PNG or WebP files at once. Images are resized in your browser before upload, so your originals never leave your device.

steps.title: AI writes the metadata
steps.body: Get a title, description, keywords and category based on the actual image, not guessed from the file name.

steps.title: Export CSV
steps.body: Download a CSV in the Adobe Stock format and upload it on the Contributor portal right away. No copying image by image.

features.title: Metadata that helps your images sell
features.subtitle: A great image nobody can find will not sell. Good titles and keywords are what help buyers find your work.

items.title: Titles that make sense
items.body: A clear line describing what is in the image, where it is and what is happening, following Adobe Stock guidelines.

items.title: Up to 50 keywords
items.body: The most important terms come first, covering objects, places, mood and concept, with no irrelevant keyword stuffing.

items.title: Category picked for you
items.body: Automatically matched to one of the 21 Adobe Stock categories, so you do not have to choose one for every image.

items.title: Brand names removed
items.body: Brand names and banned terms that get images rejected are filtered out before you see the results, and you can add your own terms to exclude.

items.title: Thai and Lao translations
items.body: The main metadata is in English, the language buyers search in, with translations so you can check the meaning before you submit.

items.title: History for every image
items.body: Every image you generate is saved, so you can copy or export it again later without generating it again.

platforms.title: Works with the stock sites you already sell on
platforms.subtitle: Export a CSV in the Adobe Stock format directly, and set title and keyword length limits to match other platforms.

items.question: Is it free?
items.answer: You can start for free. The free plan includes a monthly image quota. If you need more, contact us to upgrade your plan.

items.question: Which file types are supported?
items.answer: JPG, PNG and WebP images. You can upload many images at once.

items.question: Are my original images uploaded to your server?
items.answer: No. Images are resized in your browser first, and only the small preview is sent to the AI for analysis. Your full-resolution files never leave your device.

items.question: How do I use the CSV with Adobe Stock?
items.answer: After uploading your images to Adobe Stock Contributor, upload the CSV exported from here on the Upload CSV page. Adobe fills in the title, keywords and category for every image with a matching file name in one go.

items.question: Can I use it with platforms other than Adobe Stock?
items.answer: Yes. Choose the platforms you sell on in the Platforms page, such as Shutterstock, Freepik and iStock, then copy the metadata or export a general CSV.

closing.title: Stop typing metadata one image at a time
closing.body: Spend the time shooting more, and let {{siteName}} handle your titles and keywords.
